rites.name: Miallantium
rites.text: Miallantium is the concept of Eleniel's first resonance, the undated sounding by which the world's roots condensed out of raw song. During the Age of Strangers it became the thread outsiders gripped to anchor themselves and trade their own tunings for passage.

rites.name: Kelornareld
rites.text: Kelornareld is the concept of the Weave as it is seeded into Eleniel, the quiet thread that binds sleeping powers to the land during the Holy Age of flame and temples. It is not a being but the principle by which the orders of the age learn to wake and bind power. Its presence is felt most strongly where the temple fires burn hottest.

rites.name: Tenvamala
rites.text: Tenvamala is a concept of the Eleniel Arcane Realm, born during the Fall when the Sundering split worlds into Shards and the first Pact was sworn. It names the principle that a grove's growth can be bound to a sovereign's word, shaping the groves and young kingdoms of the first Age.

rites.name: Ilotakamuta
rites.text: Ilotakamuta is a concept in Eleniel that appears when the ending branches into the Three Futures and the Library shelves each outcome as its own volume. During the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, it was invoked to bind the chosen path and quiet the others.
